questions.q: How is the Preacher described at the start of the book?
options: The son of David, king in Jerusalem
A priest in the house of God
A servant of the king of Israel

questions.q: What does the Preacher say about the rivers?
options: They run into the sea, yet it is not full
They dry up in the summer
They carry the dust of the earth away
They will one day stop flowing

questions.q: What does the Preacher say is not satisfied with seeing?
What does the Preacher call the task of searching out all that is done under the sky?
options: A heavy burden God has given
A gift from the hand of God

questions.q: That which has been is that which shall be; and there is ____.
questions.answer: no new thing under the sun

questions.q: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and ____.
That which is crooked can't be made straight; and that which is lacking ____.

items: Vanity of vanities, all is vanity
Generations go, but the earth remains
The Preacher was king over Israel
In much wisdom is much grief

questions.q: The Preacher says one generation goes and another comes, but the earth remains forever.
The Preacher says that he who increases knowledge increases joy.
What question does the Preacher ask about man's labor under the sun?
options: What does man gain from all his labor?
Why does God require man to labor?
When will man's labor finally end?

questions.q: Which way does the wind go before it turns around to the north?
Besides wisdom, what else did the Preacher apply his heart to know?
I said to myself, 'Behold, I have obtained for myself ____ above all who were before me in Jerusalem.'
The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and ____ where it rises.
All things are full of ____.
The Preacher says the former generations are well remembered by those who come after.
What did the Preacher first test his heart with?
What did the Preacher find when he looked at all the works his hands had done?
options: All was vanity, with no profit
God was pleased with his labor

questions.q: Why did the Preacher hate all his labor?
options: He must leave it to the man after him
It had turned his heart from God

questions.q: What does God give to the sinner, according to the end of the chapter?
options: Travail, to gather and heap up

questions.q: Then I saw that wisdom excels folly, as far as ____.
The wise man's eyes are in his head, and ____.
For all his days are sorrows; yes, even in the night ____.

items: He builds houses and plants vineyards
He sees that wisdom excels folly

questions.q: The Preacher says the wise man will be remembered forever, unlike the fool.
The Preacher says the ability to eat, drink, and enjoy good in labor is from the hand of God.
Which of these did the Preacher make for himself?
options: Gardens and parks with fruit trees

questions.q: Besides silver and gold, what did the Preacher gather for himself?
options: The treasure of kings and provinces
Spices from the queen of Sheba

questions.q: Why did the Preacher make pools of water?
options: To water the forest where trees grew
To raise fish for his table
To water his herds and flocks

questions.q: What does the Preacher call it when a skilled man leaves his portion to one who did not labor for it?
options: The way of all the earth

questions.q: So I was great, and increased more than all who were before me in Jerusalem. ____ remained with me.
I said of laughter, 'It is foolishness;' and of mirth, '____?'
The Preacher says he did not keep from his eyes anything they desired.
What has God set in the hearts of men?
In the list of times, what is paired with a time to weep?
Why has God made what he does last forever, with nothing added or taken away?
options: That men should fear before him
That men should rest in it
That the wise may understand it

questions.q: What did the Preacher see in the place of justice?
A time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and ____.
He has made ____.
wrong: all things new in their season
every work perfect from the start
each day good for the righteous

questions.q: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and ____.
The Preacher says man has an advantage over the animals because man does not die as they do.
The Preacher says God seeks again that which is passed away.
In the list of times, what is paired with a time to love?
In the list of times, what is paired with a time to cast away stones?
options: A time to gather stones together

questions.q: What did the Preacher say in his heart that God will do?
options: Judge the righteous and the wicked

questions.q: What does the Preacher call it that every man should eat, drink, and enjoy good in his labor?
For everything there is a season, and a time for ____ under heaven.
I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and ____ as long as they live.
The Preacher says it is certain that the spirit of man goes upward.
Why does the Preacher say two are better than one?
options: If one falls, the other lifts him up
Two can divide the labor evenly
The king favors those with friends

questions.q: What did the oppressed lack, as the Preacher says twice?
What does the Preacher say all labor and achievement come from?
options: The envy of a man's neighbor

questions.q: What is said of the man who is alone, with neither son nor brother?
options: His eyes are not satisfied with wealth
He gives his wealth to the poor

questions.q: If two lie together, what do they have?
Two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord ____.
Better is a handful, with quietness, than ____ and chasing after wind.
Better is a poor and wise youth than ____ who doesn't know how to receive admonition any more.
The Preacher praised the living more than the dead.
The Preacher says the fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.
Who does the Preacher say is better off than both the dead and the living?
options: One who has not yet been
The wise who died long ago

questions.q: Where did the poor and wise youth come out of to become king?
What does the man with neither son nor brother ask himself?
options: For whom do I labor and deprive myself?
Who will lift me up when I fall?
When will my labor come to an end?

questions.q: Whom did the Preacher see all the living who walk under the sun were with?
options: The youth who succeeded the king
The wise men of the city

questions.q: Two are better than one, because ____ for their labor.
There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was, yet those who come after shall not ____.
The Preacher saw that power was on the side of the oppressors.
What does the Preacher say about making vows to God?
options: Better not to vow than to vow and not pay
Vows should be made only in the temple
Every vow is foolish and should be avoided
A vow may be changed if it was a mistake

questions.q: Why should your words be few before God?
options: God is in heaven, and you on earth
Silence is the sacrifice of the wise

questions.q: Why should you not marvel at the oppression of the poor in a district?
options: Each official is watched by a higher one
The poor will be repaid later
The king will soon judge it
It has always been this way

questions.q: How does a man leave this life, according to the Preacher?
options: With his riches in his hand

questions.q: What does the Preacher call wealth kept by its owner to his harm?
The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but ____ will not allow him to sleep.
Guard your steps when you go to God's house; for to draw near to listen is better than ____.
questions.answer: to give the sacrifice of fools
wrong: to make a vow in haste

questions.q: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool's speech ____.
wrong: with a heart full of pride

questions.q: The Preacher says he who loves silver will be satisfied with silver.
The Preacher says God occupies a man with the joy of his heart.
Who does the Preacher say profits from the field?
Why does the Preacher say not to delay paying a vow to God?
options: He has no pleasure in fools
The king will hear of it

questions.q: When goods increase, what does the Preacher say also increases?
What does the Preacher call it when God gives a man riches and the power to rejoice in his labor?
For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but ____.
Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, ____.
questions.answer: there is nothing in his hand
wrong: the son inherits nothing at all
the son must beg for bread

questions.q: The Preacher says that if your mouth leads you into sin, you should explain to the messenger that it was a mistake.
What evil does the Preacher describe in the rich man's life?
options: God gives him no power to enjoy it
He loses it all in war

questions.q: Who eats the rich man's wealth instead of him?
What does the Preacher ask about the wise man?
options: What advantage has he more than the fool?
Why does he not rule the city?
Why does he labor at night?

questions.q: What can man not do with him who is mightier than he?
All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet ____.
Better is the sight of the eyes than ____.
For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends ____?
The Preacher says that even if a man lives a thousand years twice and fails to enjoy good, all go to one place.
The Preacher says a man with a hundred children and many years is better off than a stillborn child, even if he is not filled with good.
What does God give the man in the evil the Preacher describes?
What does the Preacher say many words create?
Besides not being filled with good, what else does the man with a hundred children lack?
How does the Preacher describe the name of the stillborn child?
Whatever has been, its name was given ____; and it is known what man is.
Moreover it has not seen the sun nor known it. ____ rather than the other.
The Preacher says a wise man can tell another what will happen after him under the sun.
What does the Preacher say a good name is better than?
Where is the heart of the wise, according to the Preacher?
What is the laughter of the fool compared to?
options: The crackling of thorns under a pot
The noise of a flowing river

questions.q: How did God make mankind, before they searched for many inventions?
Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who ____.
Don't be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests ____.
wrong: in the heart of the proud
on the lips of the wicked

questions.q: Don't say, ____ than these? For you do not ask wisely about this.
questions.answer: Why were the former days better
wrong: Why were the old ways wiser
Why were the early years richer

questions.q: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear ____.
The Preacher says the day of one's birth is better than the day of death.
The Preacher says wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers in a city.
What does the Preacher say is better than its beginning?
What does the Preacher say a bribe destroys?
What does the Preacher ask about what God has made crooked?
options: Why did God make it so?
Who will be blamed for it?

questions.q: What does the Preacher say is the excellency of knowledge?
options: Wisdom preserves the life of him who has it
It cannot be bought with money

questions.q: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and ____; yes, God has made the one side by side with the other.
questions.answer: in the day of adversity consider
wrong: in the day of trouble pray
in the day of sorrow wait
in the day of loss mourn

questions.q: Also don't take heed to all words that are spoken, lest you hear ____.
The Preacher advises making yourself as righteous and as wise as you possibly can.
Why does the Preacher say to keep the king's command?
options: Because of the oath to God
Because the king is always wise
Because the law of Moses requires it
Because the people will praise you

questions.q: What does a man's wisdom do to his face?
Why are the hearts of men fully set to do evil?
options: Sentence against evil is not carried out speedily
The king does whatever he pleases
The righteous are forgotten in the city

questions.q: What does the Preacher say there is no discharge in?
What does the Preacher say about the king's word?
A man has no better thing under the sun than to eat, to drink, and ____.
Surely I know that it will be better with those who fear God, ____.
Even though a wise man thinks he can comprehend it, he won't ____.
The Preacher says the wicked will lengthen their days like a shadow.
The Preacher says there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked.
What does the Preacher say about whoever keeps the commandment?
options: He shall not come to harm

questions.q: What happened to the wicked the Preacher saw buried?
options: They were forgotten in the city
They were honored in the city

questions.q: Along with power over the spirit, what does no man have power over?
For he doesn't know that which will be; for who can tell him ____?
Don't be hasty ____. Don't persist in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him.
questions.answer: to go out of his presence

questions.q: The Preacher says a sinner who commits crimes a hundred times always dies young.
The Preacher says there is a time and procedure for every purpose.
Who delivered the little city from the great king?
What happened to that man after the city was delivered?
What does the Preacher say about the dead?
What are men snared in an evil time compared to?
options: Fish taken in an evil net
Grass cut down in the field

questions.q: What does the Preacher say about the words of the wise heard in quiet?
options: They are better than a ruler's cry among fools
They are like the crackling of thorns
They bring riches to the speaker

questions.q: For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than ____.
The race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong; but ____ happen to them all.
Let your garments be always white, and ____.
questions.answer: don't let your head lack oil
wrong: don't let your cup be empty
don't let your lamp go out
don't let your feet be bare

questions.q: The Preacher says there is work, planning, and wisdom in Sheol.
The Preacher says wisdom is better than weapons of war, but one sinner destroys much good.
Why does the Preacher say to eat your bread with joy?
options: God has already accepted your works

questions.q: What did the great king build against the little city?
What does the Preacher say there is to the righteous and to the wicked alike?
What does the Preacher say has perished long ago for the dead?
Whatever your hand finds to do, ____; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol.
wrong: do it with a glad heart

questions.q: The heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and ____ while they live.
The Preacher says to live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life.
What causes the oil of the perfumer to produce an evil odor?
Why should you not curse the king, even in your thoughts?
options: A bird of the sky may carry your voice
God will curse you in return

questions.q: What upside down sight does the Preacher say he has seen?
What happens by slothfulness, according to the Preacher?
What does the Preacher say if the snake bites before it is charmed?
options: The charmer's tongue has no profit

questions.q: He who digs a pit ____.
If the ax is blunt, and one doesn't sharpen the edge, then he must use more strength; but ____.
A wise man's heart is at his right hand, but ____.
questions.answer: a fool's heart at his left
wrong: a fool's heart is in his mouth
a fool's heart is in his feet

questions.q: The Preacher says that if the ruler's anger rises against you, you should leave your place.
The Preacher says, Woe to you, land, when your king is a child, and your princes eat in the morning.
What does the fool do as he walks by the way?
options: Says to everyone that he is a fool

questions.q: The words of a wise man's mouth are gracious, but what happens to a fool?
options: He is swallowed by his own lips
He is praised by other fools
He is beaten with a rod
He is driven from the city

questions.q: What does the Preacher say money is?
Why does the labor of fools weary every one of them?
options: He doesn't know how to go to the city
He only works through the night

questions.q: Happy are you, land, when your king is the son of nobles, and your princes eat in due season, ____!
questions.answer: for strength, and not for drunkenness
wrong: for joy, and not for gluttony
with thanks, and not with pride
in peace, and not in haste

questions.q: Whoever carves out stones ____. Whoever splits wood may be endangered by it.
The Preacher has seen folly set in great dignity while the rich sit in a low place.
What does the Preacher say will happen to bread cast on the waters?
options: You shall find it after many days

questions.q: What will the one who observes the wind fail to do?
Why should you give a portion to seven, even to eight?
options: You don't know what evil will be on the earth

questions.q: Rejoice, young man, in your youth; but know that for all these things ____.
questions.answer: God will bring you into judgment
wrong: you will give an account to men
your days will pass like a shadow

questions.q: In the morning sow your seed, and in the evening ____.
Truly the light is sweet, and it is a pleasant thing for the eyes ____.
The Preacher says a man who lives many years should remember the days of darkness, for they shall be many.
The Preacher says that where a tree falls, the wind will move it again.
The Preacher says we can know how the bones grow in the womb.
What do clouds that are full of rain do?
options: Hide the light of the sun

questions.q: What does the Preacher tell the young man to remove from his heart?
Just as you don't know the way of the wind, what else does the Preacher say you don't know?
options: The work of God who does all

questions.q: Therefore remove sorrow from your heart, and put away evil from your flesh; for youth and ____ are vanity.
The Preacher tells the young man to walk in the ways of his heart and in the sight of his eyes.
When does the Preacher say to remember your Creator?
options: In the days of your youth
At the end of your life
When you go to God's house

questions.q: What are the words of the wise compared to?
What happens to the spirit when the dust returns to the earth?
options: It returns to God who gave it

questions.q: What does the Preacher say of making many books?
options: It is the work of the wise
It gives rest to the soul

questions.q: What saying does the Preacher repeat near the end of the book?
options: Vanity of vanities, all is vanity
There is no new thing under the sun
For everything there is a season

questions.q: Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is ____.
Furthermore, my son, be admonished: much study is ____.
Before the silver cord is severed, or ____ is broken.
The Preacher says God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether good or evil.
Once the Preacher became wise, he stopped teaching the people.
Which lights does the Preacher say will be darkened before the evil days?
options: The sun, the light, the moon, and the stars

questions.q: Which tree does the Preacher say shall blossom?
What do the strong men do in the day the keepers of the house tremble?
What are the words from the masters of assemblies compared to?
Because man goes to his everlasting home, and ____.
questions.answer: the mourners go about the streets
wrong: his children weep at the gate

questions.q: One shall rise up at the voice of a bird, and ____ shall be brought low.
wrong: all the keepers of the house
all the singers of the city

questions.q: The Preacher says he sought out words that were pleasing, even if they were not true.
